notes.title: Overhaul update! Multiple endings and choices added!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I've been hard at work listening to your feedback and making some changes to make this a more compelling experience. 

I'm happy to say that A Gay Love Story About Gay Love has been extended to feature multiple endings, different choices and some quirky new characters! Here's a sneak peak!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38655173/5fcd6376c8e9d040beed3d7bf4be07047df5925d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38655173/5382d0b98f34f26c3adc9855fc6b6646bdfdfb40.png[/img]


Of course, the base of the game and it's story remains the same, however I think this extended version makes for a more richer experience, I hope you'll agree too!
